name: @darkfactory/root

scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm run types && tsc --project tsconfig.json && turbo run typecheck

scripts.verify: corepack pnpm run format:check && corepack pnpm run lint && corepack pnpm run typecheck && corepack pnpm run build && corepack pnpm run test:unit && corepack pnpm run test:integration && corepack pnpm run test:e2e
scripts.ci: corepack pnpm run format:check && corepack pnpm run lint && corepack pnpm run typecheck && corepack pnpm run build && corepack pnpm run test:unit && corepack pnpm run test:integration && corepack pnpm run test:e2e
scripts.doctor: node --input-type=module -e "import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process'; import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'; const [major, minor] = process.versions.node.split('.').map(Number); if (major < 22 || (major === 22 && minor < 13)) { throw new Error('Node >=22.13.0 is required; found ' + process.versions.node); } const pnpmVersion = execFileSync('corepack', ['pnpm', '--version'], { encoding: 'utf8' }).trim(); if (pnpmVersion !== '11.16.0') { throw new Error('pnpm 11.16.0 is required; found ' + pnpmVersion); } const civetVersion = execFileSync('corepack', ['pnpm', 'exec', 'civet', '--version'], { encoding: 'utf8' }).trim(); if (civetVersion !== '0.11.15') { throw new Error('Civet 0.11.15 is required; found ' + civetVersion); } for (const [manifestPath, expectedVersion] of [['node_modules/turbo/package.json', '2.10.6'], ['node_modules/vitest/package.json', '4.1.10'], ['node_modules/@playwright/test/package.json', '1.61.1'], ['apps/web/node_modules/vinext/package.json', '1.0.0-beta.3'], ['apps/web/node_modules/@vinext/cloudflare/package.json', '1.0.0-beta.3'], ['apps/web/node_modules/vite/package.json', '8.1.5']]) { const actualVersion = JSON.parse(readFileSync(manifestPath, 'utf8')).version; if (actualVersion !== expectedVersion) { throw new Error(manifestPath + ' must be ' + expectedVersion + '; found ' + actualVersion); } }" && corepack pnpm --filter @darkfactory/web exec vinext check
